boards.title: Your First Weekend at Mercy College of Ohio, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence that starts with campus resources and opens into Toledo art and riverfront space.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Library
cards.subtitle: Mercy College of Ohio • Toledo campus
cards.notes: Start by locating a dependable study and printing stop. Walk through the library, note its layout, and save the services page for later coursework.
cards.short_summary: A practical first campus stop for studying, printing, and getting oriented.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College describes its library as a place to study, print, or hang out.
cards.access_notes: Campus resource; confirm building access and service availability with Mercy College.

cards.title: Take a movement break at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the main Jefferson entrance
cards.notes: Follow the posted signs to see the fitness room and locker-room location. Bring any required waiver or access materials before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus option for a brief, equipment-based reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center has treadmills, exercise bikes, free weights, weight machines, mats, and locker rooms with showers.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the main Jefferson entrance; follow posted signs and complete any required waiver.

cards.title: Save the Food Pantry resource
cards.subtitle: Mercy College of Ohio • Toledo campus
cards.notes: If you need groceries or household support, save this page early. Eligible campus community members may visit without an appointment while the college is open.
cards.short_summary: A campus support resource to keep on hand from day one.
cards.evidence_claim: The Food Pantry is available to Mercy College students, faculty, and staff; no appointment is required.
cards.access_notes: Available to students, faculty, and staff anytime the college is open; the College requests that inquiries come from a Mercy email address.

cards.title: Find a way to participate through Student Council
cards.subtitle: Mercy College of Ohio student life
cards.notes: Read the current Student Council page and send a question to Student Life if you want to learn about organizations, activities, or ways to participate.
cards.short_summary: A documented entry point to student organizations and campus involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College says all students, including Toledo-campus and online students, are welcome to participate in Student Council.
cards.access_notes: Contact studentgovernment@mercycollege.edu or studentlife@mercycollege.edu for information about organizations and involvement.

cards.entity_name: Mercy College Campus Ministry and Service Learning
cards.title: Explore service and ministry options
cards.subtitle: Mercy College of Ohio student affairs
cards.notes: Look through the Campus Ministry and Service Learning information, then choose a future opportunity that fits your schedule rather than overfilling your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: A campus-supported route toward worship, service learning, and volunteering.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College lists Campus Ministry and Service Learning among its student-affairs resources.
cards.source_title: Student Affairs and Resources | Mercy College
cards.access_notes: Consult Mercy College Student Affairs for current opportunities and participation details.

cards.title: Make an art-museum afternoon of it
cards.subtitle: 2445 Monroe Street • Toledo
cards.notes: Set aside time to walk the main museum at your own pace. Check the visit page before leaving for current visitor guidance and exhibition details.
cards.short_summary: A free general-admission museum visit close to Mercy College’s Toledo campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Museum of Art states that general admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Visit during the museum's regular public hours; review the visit page for current details.

cards.entity_name: Toledo Museum of Art Glass Pavilion
cards.title: Continue to the Glass Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Toledo Museum of Art campus • 2445 Monroe Street
cards.notes: Add the Glass Pavilion as a separate stop after the main museum. Use the museum’s events and visit information to check what is open that day.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated glass-collection and working-studio setting on the museum campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum identifies the Glass Pavilion as the location for its public glassblowing demonstrations.
cards.source_title: Glassblowing Demonstrations | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Check the museum before travel, as Pavilion closures or special events can affect access.

cards.title: Watch the 2 p.m. glassblowing demonstration
cards.subtitle: Glass Pavilion Hot Shop • Toledo Museum of Art
cards.notes: Plan your museum route around the 2 p.m. demonstration, then arrive early enough to find the Hot Shop. Check for cancellations before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A daily public look at glassmaking by the museum’s glass artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Museum of Art offers free fine-art glassblowing demonstrations every day at 2 p.m. in the Glass Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Glassblowing Demonstrations | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Scheduled daily at 2 p.m.; annual maintenance, special events, or closures can affect the schedule.

cards.title: Take a riverside walk at Middlegrounds
cards.subtitle: 111 Ottawa Street • Toledo
cards.notes: Finish the daytime outing with the walk/bike path and Maumee River views. Stay on marked paths, dress for conditions, and leave before dark.
cards.short_summary: A downtown riverfront park with a documented walk/bike path.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlegrounds Metropark has a 1.5-mile walk/bike path and a half-mile of Maumee River frontage.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7 a.m. until dark. Metroparks Toledo states that park admission is free, though programs and attractions may charge fees.

cards.title: Turn the river walk into a scavenger hunt
cards.subtitle: Middlegrounds Metropark • 111 Ottawa Street
cards.notes: Load the listed GPS points or make it a no-device scavenger hunt. Keep to the trail and leave plants and other natural items where you find them.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided, geocaching-style activity along the Middlegrounds path.
cards.evidence_claim: Metroparks Toledo describes the Technology Explorer as a geocaching-style adventure whose information cards are visible from the trail.
cards.source_title: Metroparks Technology Explorer: Middlegrounds Metropark | Metroparks Toledo
cards.access_notes: The course begins at the Roundhouse Shelter and is described as about one mile round trip; stay on trail and do not collect or damage nature items.
